_doc: R3 P1 §12 C1 — REVIEWED page timer bounds (contract/timer-bounds.js). pages: the asserted pages and the settle() horizon their steps use. wrappers: reviewed timer wrapper names per unit. sites: every timer whose delay exceeds the page horizon or is unresolved, with reachesAsserted (does its effect reach an output a step asserts?) and the reason; bound to the call text (sha256).

sites.reason: the reviewed timer WRAPPER body (setT): its delay is its caller's — every setT call site is inventoried separately
the reviewed timer WRAPPER body (setI): its delay is its caller's — every setI call site is inventoried separately
the client-identity HEARTBEAT (a diagnostic request); it writes no DOM and no order data — it cannot reach a ticket / cart / pay-step / confirmation output
the first deploy-version check (1.5–3 s, random): it can only raise the update-required path / reload, never an asserted order output; bound 3000 ms ≤ the horizon
the 10-min deploy-version re-check + heartbeat: no asserted order output
hides the KDS cancellation banner 12 s after a CANCELLED order arrives; LP new has no cancellation (precondition not-cancelled) and the banner is not the ticket observable

the place-details timeout of the fail-state ADDRESS PICK (location escape hatch): created only when a customer picks an address suggestion; S1's GPS-OK path never creates it. Default bound 8000 ms ≤ the horizon (window.__LOC_PICK_TIMEOUT_MS is a test knob)
the outer cap on a pending address-pick waiter at pay time: created only when __locPickPromise is set (an address pick in flight); S1 has none. Default bound 10000 ms = the horizon
loadAvailability every 60 s refreshes sold-out marks on the MENU; the run's availability is a static fixture and the menu is not an asserted output in R13 / R14 / R15
